issues: Correct as far as it goes, but the explanation omits the 12%-rule: a party below the 4% national threshold can still win seats if it gets at least 12% in a single constituency (uddatalsmetoden). The option says 'kan' (can), so it is accurate, but the explanation should mention the exception so learners are not later confused.
suggestedExplanationEn: Threshold rules affect representation. A party below the 4% national threshold may get no Riksdag seats, unless it reaches the 12% constituency exception in at least one electoral district.
